verdict.rationale: Morph is an API/platform that exposes its own tools (Fast Apply, Warp-Grep, Reflexes) via an MCP server for other agents like Claude Code or Codex to consume — all evidence (morph-docs-5, morph-docs-9, morph-docs-22, morph-probe-4) shows Morph as the MCP server provider, never as a client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain their tools. This story's axis (product consuming other MCP servers) does not apply to Morph's role as a tool/model provider.
